Class HistoricalStateRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.HistoricalStateRegistry
public class HistoricalStateRegistry extends Object
Piecewise-Constant Historical State Registry.

Loads data/history/treaties_and_transitions.json at first use and provides O(log N) lookup of the geopolitical epoch active at any requested year.

Design contract: NO linear interpolation between intervals. The function getActiveEpoch(year) returns the step-constant sovereign configuration of interval [t_start, t_end) that brackets year. If the year falls before the earliest interval, the earliest interval is returned. If it falls after the last interval, the last interval is returned.

This matches the user requirement: transitions are discrete events (wars, treaties, revolutions) that change the world state abruptly, not gradually.

Singleton pattern with lazy initialisation. The registry is loaded once and cached in a static field, enabling zero-latency subsequent queries.

  • Method Details

    • getActiveEpoch

      public static HistoricalStateRegistry.HistoricalEpoch getActiveEpoch(long year)
      Returns the active geopolitical epoch for the given year (step-constant lookup).

      The epoch whose interval [t_start, t_end) brackets year is returned. Years before the earliest known epoch return the earliest epoch. Years after the last epoch return the last epoch.

      Parameters:
      year - year CE (negative for BCE, e.g. -3000 = 3000 BCE)
      Returns:
      the active HistoricalStateRegistry.HistoricalEpoch, never null

    • getActiveSovereigntySeeds

      public static List<OrographicGlottologPropagator.CulturalSeed> getActiveSovereigntySeeds(long year)
      Retrieves the polity configuration active at year as a list of OrographicGlottologPropagator.CulturalSeed objects, ready for cost-distance propagation.

      This provides a direct integration point between the registry and the orographic sovereignty rasterizer.

      Parameters:
      year - year to query
      Returns:
      list of cultural seeds derived from the active epoch's polity states
